name: Monthly Asset Disposal List
query:
select b.parent 'Bulk Disposal', b.asset Asset, a.journal_entry_for_scrap 'Scrap Journal Entry', a.status 'Status', 
    a.gross_purchase_amount 'Gross Purchase Amount', a.asset_category 'Category'
from `tabBulk Asset Disposal Item` b, tabAsset a 
where a.name=b.asset and b.parent in (
    select name 
    from `tabBulk Asset Disposal` 
    where scrap_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
) 
order by a.asset_category, b.asset;
